title: Getting Started with React
description: Learn what React is, set up your development environment, and create your first React application.
longDescription: This foundational module introduces you to React's history, its component-based philosophy, and the tooling you need to build modern web applications. You'll understand why React became the most popular frontend library and how it differs from other frameworks.
whatYouLearn: Understand what React is and why it was created
Set up a complete React development environment with Node.js and Vite
Write JSX syntax and understand how it compiles to JavaScript
Build and run your first functional React application
